Returns balances[tokenOwner].
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens without any double-spend guard.

Returns allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Approves a spender then performs an external call to receiveApproval on that spender contract.
Payable fallback that unconditionally reverts; plain ETH transfers are rejected.
onlyOwner rescue function that calls transfer on an arbitrary, user-supplied token contract.
msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for ownership, balance debiting and allowance indexing.
Arithmetic c = a + b with require(c >= a) overflow guard in safeAdd.
Arithmetic c = a - b with require(b <= a) underflow guard in safeSub.
Arithmetic c = a * b with require(a == 0 || c / a == b) overflow guard in safeMul.
Arithmetic c = a / b with require(b > 0) divide-by-zero guard in safeDiv.

edges.reason: Owned constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, so the initial owner is caller-controlled.
transferOwnership is guarded by onlyOwner which requires msg.sender == owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before handing over ownership.
transferOwnership writes the supplied _newOwner into pending owner state newOwner.
acceptOwnership reassigns the privileged owner state variable to newOwner.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
Parameter a is an operand of c = a + b in safeAdd.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a + b in safeAdd.
Result of the safeAdd addition is stored in local variable c.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a - b in safeSub.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a - b in safeSub.
Result of the safeSub subtraction is stored in local variable c.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a * b in safeMul.
Parameter b is an operand of c = a * b in safeMul.
Result of the safeMul multiplication is stored in local variable c.
Parameter a is an operand of c = a / b in safeDiv.
Parameter b is a divisor of c = a / b in safeDiv.
Result of the safeDiv division is stored in local variable c.
Constructor hard-codes _totalSupply = 50000000000.
Constructor pre-mints the whole supply into balances of a fixed address.
totalSupply() reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)].
totalSupply() reads the zero-address entry of the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the balances entry keyed by the tokenOwner parameter.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] using the caller-supplied address.
transfer credits balances[to] for the caller-supplied recipient.
transfer applies the caller-supplied token amount to the balances mapping via safeSub/safeAdd.
transfer calls safeSub on the sender balance.
transfer calls safeAdd on the recipient balance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender], indexed by the caller.
approve stores the allowance under the caller-supplied spender key.
approve stores the caller-supplied token amount as the allowance value.
transferFrom debits balances[from] using the caller-supplied source address.
transferFrom credits balances[to] using the caller-supplied destination address.
transferFrom reduces the allowance stored in allowed[from][msg.sender] by tokens.
transferFrom indexes the allowed mapping with msg.sender as spender.
transferFrom calls safeSub for the balance and allowance deductions.
transferFrom calls safeAdd for the recipient balance credit.
allowance reads allowed[tokenOwner][...] using the supplied owner key.
allowance reads allowed[...][spender] using the supplied spender key.
approveAndCall sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] and passes msg.sender to the callee.
approveAndCall writes the allowance under the caller-supplied spender address.
approveAndCall stores the caller-supplied token amount as the allowance.
approveAndCall hands control to the spender contract through receiveApproval before returning, enabling reentrancy on allowance/balance state.
Attacker-supplied data bytes are forwarded verbatim into the external receiveApproval call.
The spender address parameter is the target contract of the external receiveApproval call.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner requiring msg.sender == owner.
transferAnyERC20Token calls an arbitrary caller-supplied token contract address.
The caller-supplied token amount is forwarded to the external token contract.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call on an untrusted contract whose return value is blindly returned, allowing reentrancy or a malicious return value.
The external token transfer is directed to the owner address as recipient.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter a is only meaningful as an operand of the safeAdd addition and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter b is only meaningful as an operand of the safeAdd addition and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter a is only meaningful as an operand of the safeSub subtraction and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter b is only meaningful as the compared operand in safeSub and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter a is only meaningful as an operand of the safeMul multiplication and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter b is only meaningful as an operand of the safeMul multiplication and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter a is only meaningful as the dividend in safeDiv and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter b is only meaningful as the guarded divisor in safeDiv and should be folded into its enclosing function.
Parameter _newOwner is written straight into the newOwner state variable of transferOwnership.
Parameter to is only used as the recipient key of the balances mapping inside transfer.
Parameter tokens is only used as the amount passed to safeSub/safeAdd inside transfer.
Parameter spender is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
Parameter tokens is only used as the allowance value inside approve.
Parameter from is only used as the debited balances key inside transferFrom.
Parameter to is only used as the credited balances key inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokens is only used as the deducted allowance amount inside transferFrom.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used as the balances lookup key in balanceOf.
Parameter tokenOwner is only used as the outer allowed mapping key in allowance.
Parameter spender is only used as the inner allowed mapping key in allowance.
Parameter spender is both the allowance key and the target of the external receiveApproval call in approveAndCall.
Parameter tokens is the approved and externally forwarded amount in approveAndCall.
Parameter data flows directly into the untrusted receiveApproval call, so it belongs with that unsafe operation.
Parameter tokenAddress is the untrusted callee address of the external ERC20 transfer, so it belongs with that unsafe operation.
Parameter tokens is the amount forwarded to the untrusted external contract, so it belongs with that unsafe operation.
